question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘moving’ in the given sentence and choose the correct option.**

The old grandfather clock chimed loudly, marking the passage of time with its steady tick-tock.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Steady**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**moving**" in the given sentence refers to something that is changing or in motion. 
 
• The most appropriate antonym for "**moving**" in this context would be: **Steady** (स्थिर) - remaining constant or stable; not changing or fluctuating.
 
• Explanation of the words:
 
 
• **Steady** (स्थिर) - remaining firmly fixed, supported, or balanced; not shaking or moving.
 
• **Marking** (निशान) - making a visible mark on something to show its position or to highlight it.
 
• **Chimed** (घंटी बजाना) - sounded harmoniously or resonantly, typically with a bell.
 
• **Passage** (पास) - the act or process of moving through, under, over, or past something on the way from one place to another.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the word "**steady**" serves as** the antonym for "moving,"** as it implies something that is not changing or fluctuating.
